title: Bella ciao (melody)
edition_note: Original simplified arrangement written for OpenTiles from the traditional melody as set by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus) on Wikimedia Commons, who dedicated his setting to the public domain (CC0); not copied from any published edition or recording. Source: arrangement.txt, rendered with tools/pipeline/arrange.py. No lyrics. The origin of the tune is disputed: it is usually called a traditional Italian partisan song, but it has also been linked to a klezmer tune recorded in 1919 by Mishka Ziganoff, who died in 1967. Added on 2026-10-09 at the maintainer's request; the maintainer accepted it as a traditional melody and verified it the same day, knowing of the dispute. Revisit after the legal consultation (P2-18).
